profile.summary: Third-year Informatics and Computer Science student at Strathmore University with hands-on experience building full-stack web platforms, REST APIs, automation scripts, and USSD applications. Currently developing Sikika, a dual-channel GBV support platform reaching survivors across Kenya via both web and USSD. Experienced in Python scripting and automation, machine learning workflows, and data analysis. I care about the whole picture — the architecture, the user experience, and the real-world impact.

education.details: Relevant coursework: Software Engineering, Database Systems, Internet Application Programming, Computer Networks, OOP, Machine Learning, Design Thinking, Digital Logic, Scripting. Capstone: Sikika GBV support platform.
Prompt engineering, AI-assisted debugging, coding agents, workflow automation, and ethical considerations in AI development.

projects.description: A dual-channel platform (web + USSD) connecting gender-based violence survivors to counsellors, legal counsel, and NGO services across Kenya. Built to work for everyone — including those without smartphones — via Africa's Talking USSD integration. Multi-role auth, real-time messaging via Socket.io, OTP verification.

A modular, multi-role supply chain web platform for beverage distributors. Supports HQ Admins, Branch Managers, and Shop Owners with tailored dashboards, inventory tracking, inter-branch stock transfers, and TDD via PHPUnit.

Backend & database lead on a 5-person team. Built a university companion platform centralising assignments, events, polls and timetables. Implemented the full DB schema and Server-Sent Events for real-time notifications.

Digitalised Strathmore's manual campus pass process. Four role portals, automated approval logic, QR code generation, real-time entry scanning, and a dual-database architecture integrating the University AMS.

End-to-end Python automation for the Strathmore AMS password reset workflow. Headless browser automation, IMAP email parsing, cryptographically secure password generation, and Docker containerisation for cross-platform use.

Programmatically assembled a ranked 250-track Drake playlist on Spotify via the Web API. Custom multi-rule song matcher with version deduplication, incremental checkpointing, and a live API migration fix mid-development. Achieved 250/250 matches.

CLI tool that resolves a Spotify playlist, finds each track on YouTube via fuzzy title+duration scoring, downloads audio via yt-dlp, converts to MP3 with ffmpeg, and writes ID3 tags including embedded album art with mutagen.

Syncs a user's full Liked Songs library into a Spotify playlist with bidirectional sync — adds newly liked tracks, removes unliked ones. Handles API pagination and OAuth token caching. Clean class-based architecture.
Collaborative Java application applying OOP design principles — inheritance, encapsulation, polymorphism — built as a team with Git branching and pull request workflows.
